resources.reviewNote: CT-142Q is a separate future model.

resources.description: Future trainer for air combat systems officers and airborne electronic sensor operators.
resources.reviewNote: Scheduled replacement for the CT-142. Receipt unconfirmed in sources reviewed.

resources.description: Multi-engine trainer used through contracted flying training.
resources.reviewNote: 2 CAD explicitly maps the C-90B trainer to CT-145. The distinct BE-350 lease ended in 2024.

resources.description: Future multi-engine fixed-wing trainer.
resources.reviewNote: Scheduled replacement for the CT-145. Receipt unconfirmed in sources reviewed.

resources.name: CT-146
resources.description: Advanced rotary-wing pilot trainer.

resources.name: CT-153 Juno
resources.description: Rotary-wing trainer for the Future Aircrew Training program.

resources.name: CT-155 Hawk
resources.description: Former flying trainer now used in ground instruction or display.
resources.reviewNote: Retired from flying training in 2024. RCAF reports continued ground instruction and display use.

resources.name: CT-156 Harvard II
resources.description: Fixed-wing aircraft used for military pilot training.
resources.reviewNote: 2 CAD lists it and DND says the current training contract runs into 2027. That contract date does not establish individual aircraft disposition.

resources.name: CT-157 Siskin II
resources.description: Future fixed-wing advanced trainer and air-demonstration aircraft.
resources.reviewNote: The prime contractor confirmed arrival in Canada in September 2026 and described final RCAF delivery as a subsequent step. Final acceptance and operational service are unconfirmed in the sources reviewed.
